notes: NeoChat: pin it beside any page, size it from its corner, pick its header’s buttons (or show them only when you point at the header), mute people, quick replies, link cards and Find in your messages
Reminders and alerts: one sound and one notice however many Neopets tabs are open; closed on one tab, gone from all of them
Settings: side accounts can share your settings or have their own; the menu in cards, its colours right on every theme
Trading Post: Lot cards as one choice, pictures at 40, 60 or 80 px, View Details right on the card, and long lots no longer stretch their neighbours
Go to finds items anywhere, Neopoints over time, lookups without the captcha, pinned pages that stay put; and much more
